snippet.title: WE GOTTA GO | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
We Gotta Go is out NOW on Steam! It's a spooky, lighthearted co-op game where you and your friends speed through a haunted mansion to find the bathroom before the ghosts scare the S#!T out of you. Inspired by our shared (and embarrassing) experiences!

▴ Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967470/We_Gotta_Go/

▴ Join the Discord server:
https://discord.gg/wegottago

▴ Follow on Social Media: 
https://linktr.ee/wegottagogame
